picks.title: Second former Leelanau County finance director sues county commissioner for defamation
picks.desc: Rio Risbridger claims Commissioner Rick Robbins falsely accused her of rigging the budget to get her husband a county job; her lawsuit comes days after a similar suit against Board Chair Steve Yoder LEELANAU COUNTY- For the second time this week, a former county finance director has sued a county commissioner for defamation. On Monday, former finance director Catherine Hartesvelt sued Board Chair Steve Yoder , claiming he falsely accused her of taking part in a conspiracy to conceal financial corruption. On Thursday, Rio Risbridger, who succeeded Hartesvelt in the job, filed a lawsuit in the 13th Circuit Court against Commissioner Rick Robbins. Blake Ringsmuth of Ringsmuth Wuori PLLC represents both women.
